guide.title: How to Start a Fire With Wet Wood
guide.description: Tinder to bring from home, splitting wet wood to its dry core, building off the wet ground, feeding it slowly, and drying the next load.
guide.metaTitle: How to Start a Fire With Wet Wood
guide.metaDescription: How to start a campfire with wet wood: find the dry fuel, split to the dry core, build a big kindling base off the wet ground, and dry the next load.
